cards.title: 先写验收标准，再写代码
cards.description_en: A programmer and an AI assistant agree on acceptance criteria before writing code.
cards.description_zh: 程序员与 AI 在写代码前约定验收标准。
cards.communication_goal: 把验收标准写成可检查的预期行为。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Before you code, let's put the acceptance criteria in this document.
dialogue.zh: 写代码前，我们先把验收标准写进这份文档。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: What is the expected behavior when a required field is empty?
dialogue.zh: 必填字段为空时，预期行为是什么？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Show an error and keep the form open. Do not save an incomplete record.
dialogue.zh: 显示错误并保持表单打开，不保存不完整的记录。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Please confirm that rule. I'll use it to check the implementation.
dialogue.zh: 请确认这条规则。我会用它检查实现。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

cards.scene_prompt: The adult stick-figure programmer stands at the left of a small desk, pointing to one large rectangular paper document lying diagonally on the desk. The sheet has a clearly folded upper-right corner and completely blank black interior outlined in white. Show all four page edges, with the pointing finger beside it rather than covering it. The white OpenAI knot floats to the right. Calm discussion pose. No laptop or other paper.
cards.image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished educational scene illustration, square canvas approximately 1024x1024. Pure solid BLACK background with crisp clean WHITE line art only. Minimalist adult stick-figure programmer with circular head, thin limbs and simple expressive face. The programmer is conversing with a recognizable official OpenAI six-loop interwoven knot logo floating nearby, drawn in white with black negative spaces; the logo itself represents the AI conversational partner and has no human body. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, readable code, captions, watermark or other logos. The only brand symbol is the requested OpenAI knot. words.example: Before you code, let's put the acceptance criteria in this document.
words.translation: 写代码前，我们先把验收标准写进这份文档。
words.evidence: 验收标准由对白定义，空白纸张不能证明具体规则。

words.example: What is the expected behavior when a required field is empty?
words.translation: 必填字段为空时，预期行为是什么？
words.evidence: 预期行为是对白中的约定，没有局部可见指代。

words.example: Please confirm that rule. I'll use it to check the implementation.
words.translation: 请确认这条规则。我会用它检查实现。
words.evidence: 确认是请求中的交流行为，静态手势不能证明确认完成。

words.example: Before you code, let's put the acceptance criteria in this document.
words.translation: 写代码前，我们先把验收标准写进这份文档。
words.evidence: 对白指定纸质文档，实际纸张是局部指代；不声称能读出其内容。

cards.title: 用一个例子消除十种误解
cards.description_en: A programmer uses a concrete input and output example to clarify a requirement.
cards.description_zh: 程序员用具体的输入与输出示例澄清需求。
cards.communication_goal: 通过输入和预期输出消除需求歧义。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Let me show you an example on this tablet before you build the search.
dialogue.zh: 在你实现搜索前，我先在这台平板上给你看一个例子。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: What input should I use, and what output should I expect?
dialogue.zh: 应该使用什么输入，预期得到什么输出？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: If I search for a title with extra spaces, trim the spaces and return the matching item.
dialogue.zh: 如果我搜索的标题带有多余空格，就去掉空格并返回匹配项。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Got it. I'll also check a search with no matches.
dialogue.zh: 明白了。我还会检查没有匹配结果的搜索。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

words.evidence: 具体示例来自对白，空白屏幕不提供可读示例内容。

words.evidence: 这里指搜索结果数据，静态空白屏幕不能证明结果。

cards.title: 需求变了，怎样让 AI 跟上？
cards.description_en: A programmer asks an AI assistant to revise the plan after a requirement changes.
cards.description_zh: 需求变更后，程序员让 AI 修订计划。
cards.communication_goal: 标明过时规则，更新范围，并先确认新计划。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: The requirement has changed. Please revise the plan in this notebook.
dialogue.zh: 需求变了，请修订这个笔记本里的计划。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Which part of the old plan is outdated?
dialogue.zh: 旧计划的哪一部分已经过时？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Remove the email step. Keep the rest of the scope the same.
dialogue.zh: 移除邮件步骤，其余范围保持不变。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'll update the plan and wait for your approval before changing the code.
dialogue.zh: 我会更新计划，等你批准后再改代码。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

words.example: The requirement has changed. Please revise the plan in this notebook.
words.translation: 需求变了，请修订这个笔记本里的计划。

words.example: Which part of the old plan is outdated?

words.evidence: 过时指旧规则不再适用，不是物件外观或年龄。

words.example: Remove the email step. Keep the rest of the scope the same.
words.translation: 移除邮件步骤，其余范围保持不变。
words.evidence: 范围是需求边界，没有可见的局部指代。

words.example: The requirement has changed. Please revise the plan in this notebook.
words.translation: 需求变了，请修订这个笔记本里的计划。
words.evidence: 实际可见的纸质螺旋笔记本，不是笔记本电脑。

cards.title: 让 AI 先读项目地图
cards.description_en: A programmer asks an AI assistant to inspect the project structure before proposing changes.
cards.description_zh: 程序员让 AI 先检查项目结构，再提出改动建议。
cards.communication_goal: 先理解模块与依赖，再确定改动位置。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Before editing, inspect the project structure and open the source folder.
dialogue.zh: 编辑前，先检查项目结构并打开源代码文件夹。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Which module handles requests from the browser?
dialogue.zh: 哪个模块处理来自浏览器的请求？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Start with the API module, then trace its dependency on the database layer.
dialogue.zh: 先从 API 模块开始，再追踪它对数据库层的依赖。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'll summarize what I find before proposing a change.
dialogue.zh: 我会先总结发现，再提出改动建议。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

words.example: Before editing, inspect the project structure and open the source folder.
words.translation: 编辑前，先检查项目结构并打开源代码文件夹。

words.example: Which module handles requests from the browser?

words.evidence: 这里是软件代码模块，不能把图标框当代码模块。

words.example: Start with the API module, then trace its dependency on the database layer.

words.evidence: 软件依赖由对白说明，没有局部可见指代。

words.example: Before editing, inspect the project structure and open the source folder.
words.translation: 编辑前，先检查项目结构并打开源代码文件夹。
words.evidence: 屏幕中的文件夹图标是可定位的指代，不证明其实际内容。

cards.title: 把项目规矩写进 AGENTS.md
cards.description_en: A programmer asks an AI assistant to read the project rules in AGENTS.md before editing.
cards.description_zh: 程序员让 AI 在编辑前读取 AGENTS.md 中的项目规则。
cards.communication_goal: 把约定写进规则文件，遇到冲突先询问。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Read each instruction in AGENTS.md before you edit. The rules are also in this book.
dialogue.zh: 编辑前，请读取 AGENTS.md 中的每条指令。这本书里也有这些规则。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Should I follow the existing naming convention?
dialogue.zh: 我应该遵循已有的命名约定吗？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Yes. Follow the project rules, and ask me if two instructions conflict.
dialogue.zh: 是的。遵循项目规则，如果两条指令冲突就问我。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Understood. I'll check the rules before proposing any changes.
dialogue.zh: 明白了。我会先检查规则，再提出改动建议。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

words.translation: 编辑前，请读取 AGENTS.md 中的每条指令。这本书里也有这些规则。
